rules.universe: All historical USDT-M symbols enumerated from the official archive; PIT eligibility uses only bars with closeTime <= rebalance timestamp.
rules.actionablePortfolio: Extreme 2L+2S or 3L+3S by formation rank; breadth label is diagnostic only.
rules.execution: Signal is formed from closed daily bars; each leg uses the exact target Binance USDⓈ-M 15m open or the first official open within target + 15 minutes at the manual delay. Later candles are not execution substitutes.

costModel.execution: Signal is formed from closed daily bars; each leg uses the exact target Binance USDⓈ-M 15m open or the first official open within target + 15 minutes at the manual delay. Later candles are not execution substitutes.
costModel.funding: Funding archive schema is calc_time, funding_interval_hours, last_funding_rate; fundingRate is last_funding_rate and never a mark price. Settlement marks come only from official 1m markPriceKlines at exact fundingTime or the nearest official candle within ±1 minute. Missing marks are FUNDING_DATA_UNAVAILABLE and never a -100% funding penalty.
costModel.terminal: A position with no executable planned exit is retained under CONSERVATIVE_DELISTING: unresolved long and short legs each receive -100% leg-notional price return; ACTUAL_AVAILABLE drops only that unresolved diagnostic result.
costModel.capitalAllocation: Ex-ante sizing uses the frozen config holdingWeeks as theoretical maximum weekly-schedule concurrency; realized future peak concurrency never determines historical sleeve notional. Each sleeve receives startingCapital × targetGrossLeverage / theoreticalMaxConcurrentSleeves, with target gross leverage 2x and hard gross leverage 3x.
costModel.drawdown: REALIZED_EQUITY_DD: equity is updated only on realized ledger exit events; no mark-to-market drawdown is claimed.
costModel.executionGap: Entry and exit use the exact target 15m open or the first official 15m open within target + 15 minutes. Later candles are DATA_GAP/NOT_EXECUTABLE and are never selected.

rules.fundingCalculation: Funding archive schema is calc_time, funding_interval_hours, last_funding_rate; fundingRate is last_funding_rate and never a mark price. Settlement marks come only from official 1m markPriceKlines at exact fundingTime or the nearest official candle within ±1 minute. Missing marks are FUNDING_DATA_UNAVAILABLE and never a -100% funding penalty.
rules.markPriceSource: Binance Data Vision official futures/um/monthly/markPriceKlines/{symbol}/1m; mark open at fundingTime, nearest official ±1 minute only as recorded fallback
rules.unavailableFundingClassification: FUNDING_DATA_UNAVAILABLE; never CONSERVATIVE_DELISTING and never fundingR=-1
rules.terminalExecution: A position with no executable planned exit is retained under CONSERVATIVE_DELISTING: unresolved long and short legs each receive -100% leg-notional price return; ACTUAL_AVAILABLE drops only that unresolved diagnostic result.

Each sleeve receives startingCapital × targetGrossLeverage / theoreticalMaxConcurrentSleeves, with target gross leverage 2x and hard gross leverage 3x.
rules.combinedPromotionScore: Nested development and Confirmation A/B are never combined into a single promotion score; historical correctness pass still requires external confirmation.
